mutations.name: remove-terminal-write-guard
mutations.before: if (['completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'].includes(run.status)) throw new Error('轮次已经结束，请创建新的 runId');

mutations.name: remove-completed-input-guard
mutations.before: if (value.status === 'completed' && steps.some(step => !['completed', 'skipped'].includes(step.status))) throw new Error('完成轮次仍有未完成步骤');
